headline: The Costs
introduction: Players will receive a roster invitation that includes the estimated season cost, anticipated tournament schedule, payment deadlines, and a description of what is included. No family will be asked to accept a roster position without first receiving a clear explanation of expected expenses.
player_ids: NFL FLAG uses National Sports ID (NSID) to verify player age, grade, and eligibility for regionals, while Midwest Flag tournaments require an annual digital verification card (ZortsID).
family_note: Overnight lodging may be a consideration for 1-2 tournaments only.
assistance: RFGF will work to limit costs to families as much as possible. Limited financial assistance and payment-plan options are intended when resources allow. Requests will be handled privately and evaluated based on demonstrated need, available funding, and program expenses.
refunds: Refund eligibility will depend on which expenses the club can recover. Tournament registrations and customized uniforms generally become nonrefundable once the club commits those funds.
